title: How to use the Inbox
summary: Catch up on mentions, replies and updates — and clear them fast.

blocks.heading: Your Inbox
paragraphs: The Inbox gathers everything that needs your attention — mentions, replies, task updates and more — in one place, so nothing slips through.
Open an item to jump straight to it, dismiss with “Not now”, or clear the lot with “Mark all read”.

blocks.caption: The Inbox — open, dismiss, or clear all
blocks.alt: The Inbox panel with the open, dismiss and mark-all-read actions highlighted
